sections.text: Storage layer. The run ledger needs durable per-run state. We use Postgres for every other persistence site and Redis only for caching. Chosen: Postgres — the ledger is relational and durable, matching existing persistence.

Retention window. How long to keep completed run ledgers before pruning — 30 days keeps recent history cheap, 365 days supports quarterly audits, or keep forever. Punt: 30 vs 365 vs forever — needs human; it is a product/compliance call, not an engineering one.

Metrics export. The ledger summary is pushed to the existing StatsD sink. Assumes: the StatsD daemon configured in ops/statsd.conf is reachable from the run host; the exporter writes to it directly with no new transport.
